title: The PTMods package: a package to handle post-translational modifications
text: Post-translational modifications (PTMs) covalent modifications happen protein biosynthesis can major influence protein function. PTMs biologically important can identified high-throughput way using mass spectrometry. PTMods package focuses handling PTMs works conjuction PSMatch Spectra packages. distributes PTMs Unimod database allows convert PTM annotations multiple annotation formats. package also allows seemless addition fixed /variable PTMs using different annotation formats.

title: The PTMods package: a package to handle post-translational modifications
text: PTMs can annotated using different syntaxes: deltaMass syntax describes mass shift amino acid example "M[+15.994915]PEPTIDE" oxidation. unimodId uses unimod identifier example "M[UNIMOD:35]PEPTIDE" oxidation. modification’s name, example "M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE". convertAnnotion() function can used convert different syntaxes:
code: convertAnnotation("M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE", convertToStyle = "deltaMass") ## [1] "M[+15.994915]PEPTIDE" convertAnnotation("M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE", convertToStyle = "unimodId") ## [1] "M[UNIMOD:35]PEPTIDE" convertAnnotation("M[+15.995]PEPTIDE", convertToStyle = "name") ## [1] "M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE"

title: The PTMods package: a package to handle post-translational modifications
text: PTMs may added (formats mentioned ) using addFixedModifications() addVariableModifications() functions. latter provide combinations possible sequences given modifications. fixed modifications, N- C-terminal modifications also accepted: positional modifications, one modification applied residue position pos: Notice functions, input sequence kept (keeping already present PTM “Phospho”) whilst notation style provided also untouched. Combined convertAnnotation(), possible convert sequence preferred notation style need . variable modifications, possible limit number possible combinations using maxMods parameter: fixed variable modifications can called using addModifications(). Use convertToStyle parameter convert final sequence preferred notation style need : remove modifications sequence, use getCanonicalSequence():
code: addFixedModifications("MPEPTIDE",     fixedModifications = c(M = "Oxidation") ) ## [1] "M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE" addVariableModifications("MPEPTIDE",     variableModifications = c(M = -15.995, T = "Phospho") ) ## [1] "MPEPTIDE"                   "M[-15.995]PEPTIDE"          ## [3] "MPEPT[Phospho]IDE"          "M[-15.995]PEPT[Phospho]IDE" addFixedModifications("MPEPT[Phospho]IDE",     fixedModifications = c(Nterm = 304) ) ## [1] "[+304]-MPEPT[Phospho]IDE" addFixedModifications("APEP[Phospho]TIDE",     fixedModifications = c("Fluoro"),     pos = 1 ) ## [1] "A[Fluoro]PEP[Phospho]TIDE" addVariableModifications("MPEPTIDE",     variableModifications = c(M = -15.995, T = "Phospho"),     maxMods = 1 ) ## [1] "MPEPTIDE"          "M[-15.995]PEPTIDE" "MPEPT[Phospho]IDE" addModifications("MPEPTIDE",     fixedModifications = c(M = "Oxidation"),     variableModifications = c(T = 79.966),     convertToStyle = "unimodId" ) ## [1] "M[UNIMOD:35]PEPTIDE"            "M[UNIMOD:35]PEPT[UNIMOD:21]IDE" getCanonicalSequence("[+304]-M[Oxidation]PEPT[UNIMOD:21]IDE") ## [1] "MPEPTIDE"

title: Add fixed modifications — addFixedModifications
text: Applies fixed modifications peptide sequences. annotation style modifications already present `sequences` preserved -.  annotation style newly applied modifications matches style supplied `fixedModifications`: numeric values produce deltaMass notation (e.g. `[+79.966331]`), character values used verbatim (e.g. `[Phospho]` `[UNIMOD:21]`).

title: Add fixed modifications — addFixedModifications
code: addFixedModifications(   sequences,   fixedModifications = c(C = 57.021464),   pos = NULL )

title: Add fixed modifications — addFixedModifications
text: sequences Character vector. Peptide sequences may modifications . fixedModifications Named `numeric` `character`. `character` given, values must UniMod name UniMod ID format (e.g. `"Phospho"`, `"UNIMOD:21"`). annotation style values preserved output. Specifies fixed modifications applied amino acids. default, carbamidomethylation applied (+57.021464 cysteines). Supplying multiple modifications amino acid supported; call function consecutively instead: `pos` provided, `fixedModifications` must length `sequences`, names ignored. pos `integer(1L)` `NULL`. supplied, modification inserted specified positional residue. Names `fixedModifications` ignored. Must length `sequences`. one positional modification per sequence allowed, call function consecutively add . `pos` `NULL` (default), modifications applied occurrences named amino acids `fixedModifications`. `NA` position `` `pos` `fixedModifications` causes corresponding sequence returned unchanged.
code: "ATK" |>     addFixedModifications(c(T = "+57.024")) |>     addFixedModifications(c(T = "Phospho"))

title: Add fixed modifications — addFixedModifications
code: addFixedModifications("ATCK") #> [1] "ATC[+57.021464]K" addFixedModifications(     "ATCK",     fixedModifications = c(Nterm = 304, C = 57.02146) ) #> [1] "[+304]-ATC[+57.02146]K" addFixedModifications(     "ATSK",     fixedModifications = c(A = -42, S = 79.966331) ) #> [1] "A[-42]TS[+79.966331]K" addFixedModifications(     "ATK",     fixedModifications = c(T = "Phospho", A = 42) ) #> [1] "A[+42]T[Phospho]K" addFixedModifications("A[+42]TK", fixedModifications = c(T = "Phospho")) #> [1] "A[+42]T[Phospho]K" addFixedModifications("AT[+79.966]AK", fixedModifications = c(A = 42)) #> [1] "A[+42]T[+79.966]A[+42]K" addFixedModifications("ATA[+79.966]K", fixedModifications = c(A = 42)) #> [1] "A[+42]TA[+79.966][+42]K"  ## Positional modification addFixedModifications("ATK",     fixedModifications = c(T = "Phospho"), pos = 2L ) #> [1] "AT[Phospho]K"  ## One positional modification per sequence addFixedModifications(     c("ATK", "PQTR"),     fixedModifications = c("Phospho", 79.966),     pos = c(2L, 3L) ) #> [1] "AT[Phospho]K"  "PQT[+79.966]R"  ## Apply two modifications to the same residue consecutively "ATK" |>     addFixedModifications(c(T = "+57.024")) |>     addFixedModifications(c(T = "Phospho")) #> [1] "AT[+57.024][Phospho]K"

title: Add fixed and variable modifications to peptide sequences — addModifications
text: convenience wrapper around [addFixedModifications()] [addVariableModifications()] applies fixed variable modifications single call. Fixed modifications applied first, followed enumeration possible combinations variable modifications. Optionally, annotation style output can converted via [convertAnnotation()].

title: Add fixed and variable modifications to peptide sequences — addModifications
code: addModifications(   sequences,   fixedModifications = NULL,   variableModifications = NULL,   convertToStyle = NULL,   pos = NULL,   ... )

title: Add fixed and variable modifications to peptide sequences — addModifications
text: sequences `character`. Peptide sequences without existing modification annotations. Modifications must enclosed square brackets (e.g. `"[+79.966]K"`, `"[+304]-ATK"`). fixedModifications Named `numeric` `character`, `NULL`. Fixed modifications applied unconditionally specified amino acids termini. Names correspond single-letter amino acid codes, `"Nterm"`, `"Cterm"`. `character`, values must UniMod name UniMod ID format (e.g. `"Phospho"`, `"UNIMOD:21"`). See [addFixedModifications()] full details. Set `NULL` skip. variableModifications Named `numeric` `character`, `NULL`. Variable modifications enumerate specified amino acids. Names correspond single-letter amino acid codes. `character`, values must UniMod name UniMod ID format. See [addVariableModifications()] full details. Set `NULL` skip. convertToStyle `character(1)`. Controls annotation format modifications returned sequences. One : `NULL` (default) input modification style. `"deltaMass"` Delta mass notation, e.g. `[+79.966]`. `"unimodId"` UniMod ID notation, e.g. `[UNIMOD:21]`. `"name"` UniMod name notation, e.g. `[Phospho]`. Conversion performed [convertAnnotation()]. pos `integer` `NULL`. supplied, fixed modifications applied 1-based canonical positions rather amino-acid name. Must length `sequences`. Forwarded [addFixedModifications()]. Ignored `fixedModifications` `NULL`. ... Additional arguments passed underlying modification functions. Currently supported: `maxMods` Forwarded [addVariableModifications()].     `numeric(1)` specifying maximum number variable modifications     may applied simultaneously. Defaults `Inf`.

title: Add fixed and variable modifications to peptide sequences — addModifications
text: `character` vector peptidoforms. length greater   equal `length(sequences)`, input sequence may expand   multiple peptidoforms corresponding combinations variable   modifications.

title: Add fixed and variable modifications to peptide sequences — addModifications
text: Guillaume Deflandre <guillaume.deflandre@uclouvain.>

title: Add fixed and variable modifications to peptide sequences — addModifications
code: ## Fixed modifications only addModifications(     c("ATCK", "PEPCK"),     fixedModifications = c(C = 57.02146) ) #> [1] "ATC[+57.02146]K"  "PEPC[+57.02146]K"  ## Variable modifications only addModifications(     c("ATSK", "PEPTSK"),     variableModifications = c(S = 79.966331, T = 79.966331),     maxMods = 2 ) #> [1] "ATSK"                           "AT[+79.966331]SK"               #> [3] "ATS[+79.966331]K"               "AT[+79.966331]S[+79.966331]K"   #> [5] "PEPTSK"                         "PEPT[+79.966331]SK"             #> [7] "PEPTS[+79.966331]K"             "PEPT[+79.966331]S[+79.966331]K"  ## Both fixed and variable modifications addModifications(     "ATCSK",     fixedModifications = c(C = 57.02146),     variableModifications = c(S = 79.966331, T = 79.966331),     maxMods = 1 ) #> [1] "ATC[+57.02146]SK"             "AT[+79.966331]C[+57.02146]SK" #> [3] "ATC[+57.02146]S[+79.966331]K"  ## Return annotations in UniMod name style addModifications(     "ATSK",     variableModifications = c(S = 79.966331, T = 79.966331),     convertToStyle = "name" ) #> [1] "ATSK"                   "AT[Phospho]SK"          "ATS[Phospho]K"          #> [4] "AT[Phospho]S[Phospho]K"  ## N-terminal fixed modification with variable modifications addModifications(     "ATSK",     fixedModifications = c(Nterm = 304),     variableModifications = c(S = 79.966331) ) #> [1] "[+304]-ATSK"             "[+304]-ATS[+79.966331]K"  ## Positional fixed modification addModifications(     c("ATK", "PQTR"),     fixedModifications = c("Phospho", 79.966),     pos = c(2L, 3L) ) #> [1] "AT[Phospho]K"  "PQT[+79.966]R"

code: addVariableModifications(     "APGHKA",     variableModifications = c(A = 4, K = 5, S = 8),     maxMods = 2 ) #> [1] "APGHKA"         "A[+4]PGHKA"     "APGHK[+5]A"     "APGHKA[+4]"     #> [5] "A[+4]PGHK[+5]A" "A[+4]PGHKA[+4]" "APGHK[+5]A[+4]" addVariableModifications(     "APGHKA",     variableModifications = c(A = 4, K = 5, S = 8),     maxMods = 3 ) #> [1] "APGHKA"             "A[+4]PGHKA"         "APGHK[+5]A"         #> [4] "APGHKA[+4]"         "A[+4]PGHK[+5]A"     "A[+4]PGHKA[+4]"     #> [7] "APGHK[+5]A[+4]"     "A[+4]PGHK[+5]A[+4]" addVariableModifications(     c("ATK", "PAK"),     variableModifications = c(T = "Phospho", A = "UNIMOD:1") ) #> [1] "ATK"                    "A[UNIMOD:1]TK"          "AT[Phospho]K"           #> [4] "A[UNIMOD:1]T[Phospho]K" "PAK"                    "PA[UNIMOD:1]K"          addVariableModifications(     "A[+10]KT[-5]",     variableModifications = c(A = -20, T = "Phospho") ) #> [1] "A[+10]KT[-5]"               "A[+10][-20]KT[-5]"          #> [3] "A[+10]KT[-5][Phospho]"      "A[+10][-20]KT[-5][Phospho]"  ## Apply two modifications to the same residue consecutively "ATK" |>     addVariableModifications(c(T = "+57.024")) |>     addVariableModifications(c(T = "Phospho")) #> [1] "ATK"                   "AT[Phospho]K"          "AT[+57.024]K"          #> [4] "AT[+57.024][Phospho]K"

title: Convert sequences from one annotation style to another — convertAnnotation
text: function handles three main conversion scenarios: Name deltaMass: "M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE" -> "M[+15.994915]PEPTIDE" Name unimodId: "M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE" -> "M[UNIMOD:35]PEPTIDE" deltaMass name: "M[+15.995]PEPTIDE" -> "M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE" deltaMass unimodId: "M[+15.995]PEPTIDE" -> "M[UNIMOD:35]PEPTIDE" unimodId name: "M[UNIMOD:35]PEPTIDE" -> "M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE" unimodId deltaMass: "M[UNIMOD:35]PEPTIDE" -> "M[+15.994915]PEPTIDE"

title: Convert sequences from one annotation style to another — convertAnnotation
text: Guillaume Deflandre <guillaume.deflandre@uclouvain.>

title: Convert sequences from one annotation style to another — convertAnnotation
code: # Convert sequence from name to delta mass convertAnnotation("M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE", convertToStyle = "deltaMass") #> [1] "M[+15.994915]PEPTIDE" # Result: "M[+15.994915]PEPTIDE"  # Name to Unimod ID convertAnnotation("M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE", convertToStyle = "unimodId") #> [1] "M[UNIMOD:35]PEPTIDE" # Result: "M[UNIMOD:35]PEPTIDE"  # Delta mass to name convertAnnotation("M[+15.995]PEPTIDE", convertToStyle = "name") #> [1] "M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE" # Result: "M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE"  # Multiple modifications convertAnnotation("M[Oxidation]EVNES[Phospho]PEK", convertToStyle = "deltaMass") #> [1] "M[+15.994915]EVNES[+79.966331]PEK" # Result: "M[+15.994915]EVNES[+79.966331]PEK"  # Convert multiple sequences from name to delta mass sequences <- c("M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE", "EVNES[Phospho]PEK", "PEPTIDE") convertAnnotation(sequences, convertToStyle = "deltaMass") #> [1] "M[+15.994915]PEPTIDE" "EVNES[+79.966331]PEK" "PEPTIDE"              # Result: c("M[+15.994915]PEPTIDE", "EVNES[+79.966331]PEK", "PEPTIDE")  # Convert from delta mass to name sequences <- c("M[+15.995]PEPTIDE", "S[+79.966]EQUENCE") convertAnnotation(sequences, convertToStyle = "name") #> [1] "M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE" "S[Phospho]EQUENCE"   # Result: c("M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE", "S[Phospho]EQUENCE")  # Convert to Unimod IDs sequences <- c("M[Oxidation]PEPTIDE", "C[Carbamidomethyl]PEPTIDE") convertAnnotation(sequences, convertToStyle = "unimodId") #> [1] "M[UNIMOD:35]PEPTIDE" "C[UNIMOD:4]PEPTIDE"  # Result: c("M[UNIMOD:35]PEPTIDE", "C[UNIMOD:4]PEPTIDE")

what: Extract modification counts from one or more peptide sequences — getModificationsCounts
title: Extract modification counts from one or more peptide sequences — getModificationsCounts
text: Given character vector peptide sequences containing modifications annotation style (deltaMass, UniMod ID, name), returns named integer vector count unique modification. Regardless input annotation style, modifications converted UniMod name output (e.g. `[+79.966]` `[UNIMOD:21]` appear `Phospho`).

title: Extract modification counts from one or more peptide sequences — getModificationsCounts
code: getModificationsCounts(sequences)

title: Extract modification counts from one or more peptide sequences — getModificationsCounts
text: sequences `character()` vector peptide sequences ProForma format.

title: Extract modification counts from one or more peptide sequences — getModificationsCounts
text: named integer vector names UniMod modification names values occurrence counts across input sequences. Returns empty integer vector modifications found.

title: Extract modification counts from one or more peptide sequences — getModificationsCounts
text: Guillaume Deflandre <guillaume.deflandre@uclouvain.>
